api_version.semantic_candidate_policy: A semver-shaped Gradle/AndroidManifest literal is manual version evidence; only a dedicated version-control subject can be a semantic-management candidate. CHANGELOG headings and Git tags are not version records.

has_interface_abstraction.classification_policy: Requires an explicitly platform/version/architecture-named adapter or strategy declaration, a current-head implementation, and an actual platform, SDK/version, ABI, or non-compatible API call inside that implementation. Only a status actually covered by such a call receives the abstraction cap; UI callbacks, providers, names alone, and arbitrary abstract classes do not qualify.

version_bound_status.classification_policy: Only current-platform Build.VERSION.SDK_INT control flow and specified RequiresApi/TargetApi annotations are in scope. Comparisons of an app's targetSdkVersion metadata with VERSION_CODES are excluded.
